intro: Everything you can do in THE MARKET, step by step. Pick a chapter. Keys look like [THIS]; you can change most of them in [ESC], SETTINGS, KEYS. Every move and key is also in WHAT YOU CAN DO: press [?].

chapters.title: GETTING STARTED
chapters.what: Walk, run, jump and use things. Almost everything is used by double-clicking it.
steps: Walk with [W] [A] [S] [D] or the arrow keys, or click the ground to walk there.
Hold [SHIFT] to run. Press [SPACE] to jump. Hold [C] to crouch.
Double-click a thing to walk to it and use it: a door, a seat, a lamp, a person. [E] uses what is in front of you.
Double-click yourself for your paper doll: what you wear, your skills, your journal and passport.
Press [?] for WHAT YOU CAN DO: every activity and its keys. Press [ESC] for the menu.
Your game saves by itself. Next time you come back where you left off.

chapters.title: THE CAMERA AND VIEWS
chapters.what: Look at the world from above, from behind you or through your own eyes.
steps: Press [V] for the next view: the overhead view in town; third and first person inside and in Central Park.
[R] turns the view (hold it in third and first person). [Q] turns you left. Tilt with [Z] and [X].
Zoom with the mouse wheel. Drag with the mouse to move the view or look round.
In first person, click to let the mouse turn your head; [ESC] lets it go.
Press [0] to put the view back. [`] is the free camera: [W] [A] [S] [D], [SPACE] up, [SHIFT] down, [`] again to come back.
tips: More view settings are in [ESC], SETTINGS, VIEW and CAMERA.

chapters.title: MENU, PACK AND MAP
chapters.what: One menu for everything: what you can do, your pets, your things, the map, this guide, the people on your block and the settings.

sections.head: THE MENU
steps: Press [ESC]. Its sections run down the left: SETTINGS, WHAT YOU CAN DO, PETS, INVENTORY, MAP, GUIDE and PEOPLE. Each has tabs along the top.
PEOPLE: who is on your block, and VISIT their apartment.
[ESC] again shuts the menu.

sections.head: YOUR THINGS
steps: Press [I] for your bag: everything you carry. Drag a thing out to drop it, onto your paper doll to wear it, or onto the quick bar.
[1] to [0] use a filled quick bar slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.
INVENTORY in the menu has BAG, SKILLS, BOOK, FISHING and JOURNAL. BOOK keeps a page for each thing you collect.

sections.head: THE MAP
steps: Press [SHIFT] + [M], or MAP in the menu. Its tabs: STREET, SUBWAY, UNDERGROUND and GO TO.
Click a place to go there. GO TO lists every place A to Z, your neighbours' apartments, and MY APARTMENT at the top.
Wheel zooms, drag moves the map.

chapters.title: YOUR CHARACTER
chapters.what: Your paper doll: what you wear, your skills, your journal and your passport.
steps: Double-click yourself to open your paper doll. Drag to turn it, wheel to zoom.
Its buttons: EDIT, WEAR, WORDS, SKILLS, JOURNAL, EMOTES, PASSPORT and LOG OUT.
Drag clothes from your bag onto it to wear them. Clothes come from the bodega's shelves and from the Clothier at the movie theatre.
Press [;] to take your shoes off or put them on (barefoot to forage).

chapters.title: YOUR APARTMENT
chapters.what: Your own home. Fill it with furniture and make it yours.

sections.head: GETTING IN AND OUT
steps: Double-click YOUR APARTMENT on the street, or MAP, GO TO, MY APARTMENT.
The hall has the elevator, the stairs down, the stairs up to the roof and your mailbox.
The FIRE ESCAPE DOOR takes you out onto your fire escape. Double-click a window to open it.

sections.head: DECORATING
steps: At home, press [T]. Click a thing to pick it up and drag it: green means it fits.
Turn it with [Q] [E]. Size it with [SHIFT] + wheel. Lower or raise it with [[] and []]. [G] turns the grid on or off.
[X] or [DELETE] puts it away. [CTRL] + [Z] undoes. [ESC] when you are done.

sections.head: THE COMPUTER
steps: Double-click THE COMPUTER: the BBS. Order from the bodega or the furniture catalog, or play the arcade games.
A drone flies your order to your fire escape. Double-click A PARCEL to bring it in.

sections.head: AT HOME
steps: Double-click the TV, the radio, the light switch, the typewriter, the telescope, the globes, the microscope, the fish tank or a pot to use it.

chapters.title: MONEY AND SHOPS
chapters.what: You start with $1,000,000. Buy from the merchants and sell them what you find.
steps: Double-click a merchant or a shop counter. Double-click a row to buy or sell; [ENTER] says yes, [ESC] no.
Or drag a thing from your bag onto a shopkeeper to sell it.
An EXCHANGE MACHINE on the street buys anything at half its worth.

Who buys what: the Mushroom Seller mushrooms; the Tomato vegetables, fruit and flowers; the fish market's stalls and the Fisherman in Waders fish; the Park Ranger butterflies; the Forest Ranger birds; the Village Gardener honey; the Professor paintings, finds and fossils; the Samurai Warrior swords; the Rock Golem gems.
Rent a table on Market St's row to sell your own things: +1 DAY, then PUT 1 or ALL, and collect the till.
To look closely at something, press [5]. Drag to turn it, wheel to zoom.

chapters.title: THE SHOPS
chapters.what: Double-click a shop's door to go in. Most keepers stand behind their counter.

sections.head: SHOPS
steps: THE BODEGA: double-click the register for everything it sells (pet food, spray paint, balloons, plants, clothes...), and pay yourself. Mango the cat mends you if you feed her cat food.
DOGS & CATS, LIZARDS & DRAGONS and THE BIRD SHOP: adopt a pet. THE BUTTERFLY SHOP: butterflies and bees.
THE AQUARIUM: buy fish for your tank.
THE ARMOURY. THE SKATE SHOP: skateboards, BMX, hover boards and the go-kart.
FISHING & SCUBA: rods, reels, lures, bait, coolers, goggles, a headlight and the scuba set.
THE CLINIC: the Doctor.
THE BOOKSTORE: the free library, the table games and the Professor. THE BAR: the Badger pours ale, stout and cola; darts and pool.

sections.head: STALLS
steps: At the park wall: THE BUTTERFLY STALL (the Park Ranger), THE BEEKEEPER'S STALL (the Village Gardener), THE BIRD STALL (the Forest Ranger) and THE GEM STALL (the Rock Golem).
THE MUSHROOM STALL (the Mushroom Seller) and THE VEGETABLE STALL (the Tomato).
THE FISH MARKET and THE FISH TABLES: four fish sellers who buy your catch.

sections.head: PLACES
steps: THE BANK, THE MOVIE THEATRE, THE PLAYHOUSE, THE ART MUSEUM, THE ARCADE, KNUCKLE & IRON (the gym), THE STRANGEST LANES (bowling) and THE OBSERVATORY (see PLACES TO GO).

chapters.title: THE BANK
chapters.what: Your account and your own vault.
steps: Go into THE BANK. The teller puts money in and takes it out of your account.
By the bank, press [ENTER] and say BANK in chat. Your vault opens: click moves one thing, [SHIFT] + click all of them.

chapters.title: TALKING TO PEOPLE
chapters.what: The people of THE MARKET talk, remember you, and some have work for you.
steps: Double-click a character. You walk up and they speak.
Pick an answer with [W] [S] or the arrows, then [E], [SPACE] or [ENTER]. Or press [1] to [9].
Press [ESC] to walk away.

chapters.title: YOUR DRONE
chapters.what: PIP, the little drone that flies with you.
steps: Double-click PIP for its menu: WHERE IS, HOW DO I, WHAT'S THIS and TIPS.
Pick a place under WHERE IS and PIP flies ahead of you to it. STOP LEADING ends it.
If something hits you, PIP zaps it back. It needs a few seconds between zaps.
When your health is low, PIP patches you up.
Send it off or call it back with FLYING BOT in the menu's CHAT.

chapters.title: FORAGING
chapters.what: Pick mushrooms and flowers in the park and sell them.
steps: Go to a park lawn. Press [;] to take your shoes off.
Double-click a mushroom, a fairy ring or wildflowers to pick them.
In your bag: eat or identify.
Your BOOK ([ESC], INVENTORY, BOOK) keeps a page for each thing you collect.
Grow your own: seeds and saplings from the Tomato. Plant seeds from your pack on bare lawn (up to 12), or claim a plot at its post.
The Mushroom Seller buys mushrooms and trains FORAGING and MYCOLOGY. The Tomato buys vegetables, fruit and flowers.

chapters.title: SKILLS AND LESSONS
chapters.what: Get better at what you do.

sections.head: SKILLS
steps: [ESC], INVENTORY, SKILLS. A skill grows each time you use it.
Each skill has a rank: NOVICE, APPRENTICE, JOURNEYMAN, EXPERT, ADEPT, MASTER and GRANDMASTER. Master a trainer's skill and its title shows over your head.

sections.head: TRAINERS
steps: Each trainer asks you to find harder and harder things for their skill, and pays two to five times their worth.

The Mushroom Seller: FORAGING, MYCOLOGY. The Tomato: GARDENING. The Fisherman in Waders: FISHING. The Park Ranger: BUTTERFLIES. The Village Gardener: BEEKEEPING. The Rock Golem: GEMS. The Forest Ranger: BIRDING, CLIMBING, PHOTOGRAPHY. The Professor: PALAEONTOLOGY. The Samurai Warrior: SWORDS. The Squirrel: FIGHTING.
Some merchants also sell a LESSON in what they buy (TRAIN).

sections.head: PRACTICE
steps: The SPARRING DUMMY on the park lawn by the Squirrel's Tower: with a blade it trains SWORDSMANSHIP, bare-handed MARTIAL ARTS (to 40).
The arcade cabinets train skills too. Climb trees and ladders for CLIMBING.

chapters.title: PAINTING
chapters.what: Paint a picture and sell it.
steps: Paint on the easel at home, or on a canvas from your pack.
[B] brush, [P] pencil, [A] airbrush, [E] eraser, [S] smudge, [G] fill. [[] and []] size the brush.
FINISH signs it. Hang it with DECORATE ([T]).
The Professor buys paintings.

chapters.title: THE BOOKSTORE
chapters.what: A free library, table games, and the Professor.
steps: Go into THE BOOKSTORE. Double-click a bookcase to look along the spines.
Click a spine to open it. Borrow up to five and read them anywhere; hand them back at RETURNS.
In the café, double-click a chair at a table to play one of 40 table games (chess, go, backgammon, cards...), with the computer or another player.

chapters.title: HEALTH, STAMINA AND HEALING
chapters.what: Your health, stamina and air bars.
steps: Running, fighting and blocking use stamina. Stop for a moment and it fills again.
Health mends by itself, but not in a fight. Sitting mends you faster.
At no health you faint; in a death fight you die (see IF YOU DIE).
THE CLINIC's Doctor sells implants.

chapters.title: FISHING
chapters.what: Fish the Hudson from the pier, or THE LAKE in the park.

sections.head: GET READY
steps: Go into FISHING & SCUBA. Buy a FISHING ROD and BAIT.
Hold the rod: press [1] until you hold it, or HOLD in your pack.
Stand by the water (the Hudson pier, the lake) and press [F].

sections.head: CAST AND CATCH
steps: Hold [SPACE], let go to cast.
When it bites, press [SPACE] to strike. Hold [SPACE] to reel in.
In the fight, [A] [D] pull the rod against the fish's run. [W] [S] set the drag. [B] changes the bait.
When it is out of the water, [SPACE] unhooks it. [F] or [ESC] stops.

sections.head: WHAT BITES
steps: Your pack's FISHING tab tells you what bites where.
When the big lake freezes, drill a hole with an ice auger and fish it.
Sell your catch at the fish market's stalls or to the Fisherman in Waders.

chapters.title: COOLERS
chapters.what: Carry more fish.
steps: You carry a few fish in your hands. A cooler holds more: small and medium coolers come from the fish market's stalls.

chapters.title: BUTTERFLIES AND BIRDS
chapters.what: Catch butterflies with a net, tame birds, collect them or sell them.

sections.head: BUTTERFLIES
steps: Buy a BUTTERFLY NET from the Park Ranger at THE BUTTERFLY STALL. He buys butterflies.
Double-click a settled butterfly to catch it, or hold the net and click to swing it through one on the wing.
Your hands hold 5; a jar holds more. In your pack: IDENTIFY or RELEASE.

sections.head: BIRDS
steps: Double-click a bird: WATCH, TAME (needs birdseed) or CATCH (needs a bird net and an empty cage).
The Forest Ranger at THE BIRD STALL sells birdseed, bird nets, cages, a feeder, binoculars and a camera, and buys birds.
Hang a feeder from your pack. Pick up the feathers birds leave.
At dawn on the Hudson, double-click a great blue heron and keep still for a feather.

sections.head: FIREFLIES
steps: At night by the pond, double-click one to cup it. An empty jar keeps a glowing jar.

chapters.title: BEES AND HONEY
chapters.what: Keep bees in the park and take their honey.
steps: Buy a HIVE, JARS, a SMOKER and a VEIL from the Village Gardener at THE BEEKEEPER'S STALL.
Stand on a park lawn among flowers and press SET IT HERE on the hive in your pack.
The hive fills over real time, faster among flowers.
Double-click it and press TAKE HONEY. The smoker calms the bees; the veil keeps stings off. LIFT IT puts it back in your pack.
The hollow oak is a wild hive: smoke it for honey, sometimes a queen.
The Village Gardener buys honey.

chapters.title: SWIMMING AND DIVING
chapters.what: Swim the Hudson and dive to the bottom.
steps: Walk into deep water to swim.
[SPACE] swims down, [SHIFT] swims up. In first person you swim where you look.
Your air runs out under water. Breathing mushrooms give you more; the scuba set from FISHING & SCUBA gives you a tank.
Goggles see through murky water; a headlight lights the deep.
Down in the Hudson: the pirate wreck's sunken chest, a sunken safe, and the captain's logbook.

chapters.title: FLYING
chapters.what: Eat a DRIFTCAP MUSHROOM and fly like a superhero for five minutes, anywhere on the map, over everything and up through the clouds. You wear a cape while you fly.
steps: Eat a flight mushroom from your pack.
Press [G] to take off.
Fly with [W] [A] [S] [D]: the longer you go one way, the faster. [SPACE] up (through the clouds), [SHIFT] down.
[G] again lands. You land by yourself when it wears off.

chapters.title: ROWBOAT AND BOARDS
chapters.what: Get out on the water or ride a board.

sections.head: ROWBOAT
steps: Rowboats wait by the long pier, $5 a trip.
Row with [W] [A] [S] [D]. [F] fishes from the boat.
STEP ASHORE at a ladder or the pier.

sections.head: BOARDS
steps: THE SKATE SHOP sells skateboards, BMX bikes, hover boards and the go-kart. Hold one and press [E] to get on.
Steer with [W] [A] [S] [D]. On a skateboard, hold [SPACE] and let go to ollie; [J] flips, [K] grabs, [L] grinds.
[E] again gets off.

sections.head: CARS AND MORE
steps: Double-click a parked car on Market St to drive it: [W] [S] go and brake, [A] [D] steer, [T] the radio, [H] the horn, [F] gets out.
Double-click a hover car, the submersible at the river pier, or the news helicopter on the helipad up the bank stairs.
The black balloon from the bodega lifts you; a magic carpet, a saddle and the horse if you own them.

chapters.title: FIGHTING
chapters.what: Fists, feet and swords. Fight the dungeon's monsters, or other players.
steps: [J] punches, [K] kicks, [N] slaps, [L] side kicks. Press again in time to chain a combo.
Hold [C] to crouch, then [J] uppercut or [K] sweep. [2] leg sweep, [3] back flip, [4] front flip, [Y] roll, [U] cartwheel, [O] dodge back.
Hold [P] to block. With a sword, a block on the beat staggers them.
Swords: from the Samurai Warrior. Press [1] to hold it; the mouse aims, a click swings. Three quick swings make the third a heavy one.
KNUCKLE & IRON is the gym: the bags, the ring and the weights.
THE DUNGEON is down the dungeon stair in Central Park. The guardians at the stair pay bounties for what you slay below.
Held by a player? Mash any key to break free.

chapters.title: IF YOU DIE
chapters.what: You become a ghost. You can come back.
steps: As a ghost you can walk and go through doors, but not fight or use most things.
Float to THE BATH HOUSE on the lake's island and stand ten seconds in its steam. Or press RESURRECT on your paper doll.
Your body keeps your things for an hour: double-click it.

chapters.title: THE SUBWAY AND OTHER SECTIONS
chapters.what: Ride the trains, and visit the other sections of the city.
steps: Walk down a station's stairs.
Walk in through an open door. Double-click a seat to sit, or a pole or strap to hold on.
Walk out at a station. The passport machine opens the exit gate.
Double-click THE LOOP MAP for the trains and times. MAP, SUBWAY shows every station: click one to ride there.

chapters.title: BROCHURES
chapters.what: A leaflet for each thing to do: what it is, where it is, how to do it and what it costs.
steps: Find a brochure rack on the street: by the park gate, on Market St, or on the Hudson walk. Each is $2.
Read them from your pack: READ. Click the cover to open it.
START takes you there and lends you what it needs; the loan goes back when you leave.
Collect all twelve: a full set pays $50.

chapters.title: PLACES TO GO
chapters.what: Double-click a door to go in. Double-click OUT TO THE STREET to leave.

sections.head: THE ARCADE
steps: Double-click PLAY on a cabinet (free): RAINBOW RUN, GALAXY RAID, MAZE, ROAD 85, TORCHBEARER, PETRI. [ESC] leaves.
Skee-ball, the claw and air hockey are free too.

Pinball (POOH, MICKEY): double-click a table. [A] [D] the flippers, hold [SPACE] and let go for the plunger. [ESC] steps away. On a pad: LB and RB (or the triggers) the flippers, A the plunger, B steps away. In the headset each hand's trigger is its flipper.

sections.head: THE HOLODECK (BACK OF THE ARCADE)
steps: Double-click the holodeck panel and run ROAM.

sections.head: THE MOVIE THEATRE
steps: A ticket is $5 from the Ticket Fox at the box office; the door takes it.
Sit in a row to watch: it rests you. Double-click THE SCREEN for your sound and full screen.

sections.head: THE PLAYHOUSE
steps: Buy a ticket ($8) at the pay hatch in the gate passage. Sit on a bench while the play is on and it rests you.

sections.head: THE ART MUSEUM
steps: Double-click a painting to look closely: wheel zooms, drag looks round.

sections.head: MORE
steps: THE STRANGEST LANES: four lanes of bowling. THE OBSERVATORY: the park's telescope.
THE SQUIRREL'S TOWER in the park: the ladder up to the spyglass.
THE DUNGEON STAIR in Central Park goes down to the dungeon.

chapters.title: OTHER PLAYERS AND CHAT
chapters.what: Everyone in your section is here with you.
steps: Other players walk, fish, fight and wear what they wear, just like you.
Press [ENTER] to chat. Type, then [ENTER] to send ([ESC] closes).
[ESC], PEOPLE lists the players on your block. VISIT THEIR APARTMENT takes you in to look; you cannot change anything.
Double-click a player to message them, trade, see their ID card or visit.

chapters.title: TRADING
chapters.what: Swap things with other players.
steps: Double-click a player and choose TRADE, or drag a thing from your bag onto them.
Put in things or cash. When you both ACCEPT, it is done.

chapters.title: SETTINGS, KEYS AND BUGS
chapters.what: Make the game look and play the way you like.
steps: [ESC], SETTINGS. Every setting has its own tab: VIEW, CAMERA, SCREEN, CHAT, RESOLUTION, PS2 FILTER, TIME, WEATHER, LIGHT, SOUND, KEYS, CONTROLLER and VR.
KEYS: click a key, then press the one you want.
Found something broken? Press [F8] (or SETTINGS, REPORT A BUG), say what happened, and SEND.
Got a Quest 3? Open THE MARKET in its browser and press ENTER VR, or SETTINGS, VR.
